stem:
Jamia can rent a moving truck from Company A for $49.00 plus $0.65 per mile. She can rent a moving truck from Company B for $60.00 plus $0.55 per mile.

Write an inequality that represents the minimum number of miles, x, for which the cost of renting a moving truck from Company A is greater than the cost from Company B.
instruction: Enter your answers in the boxes provided.
